title: DSH capability
description: One capability a plugin contributes to the person-like platform. The platform selects capabilities, loads their prompts, enforces effects/permissions, and delivers declared outputs.

id.description: Stable, namespaced capability id, e.g. image.generate or communication.qq.

kind.description: Which part of the person this capability represents.

description.description: Model-facing description of what this capability does.

input.description: JSON Schema for the capability input.

output.description: JSON Schema for the capability result.

effects.description: Side effects the platform must govern.

permissions.description: Platform permissions required to invoke this capability.

prompts.description: Prompt files scoped to this capability.

bind.description: Implementation binding. action/communication capabilities MUST provide one.

delivery.description: Media kinds this capability may ask the platform to deliver.

recovery.description: How the platform may recover without re-invoking the capability.

when.description: Optional activation conditions for prompt loading.
